_note: 英語島文法分區（最後一批）：數量代名詞與動詞一致（eng.t_adv.pron.quantifier-agreement，學測級）。-one/-body/-thing 不定代名詞＝單數（Everyone is）；each/every/neither+單數名詞＝單數（Each of the boys has；Neither answer is）；both＝複數（Both are）；all/some of + 複數名詞＝複數、all/some of + 不可數＝單數。刻意避開 none of ... is/are（兩可）與 everyone...their/his or her（兩可）當單選。形式依 Swan/Cambridge，provisional，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。text-only shadowing、無音檔。

units.title_zh: 數量代名詞與動詞的一致（both/either/neither/all/each）
units.can_do: 我能讓動詞和數量代名詞一致：everyone/something 用單數（Everyone is here）；each of / neither + 單數名詞用單數（Each of the boys has；Neither answer is）；both 用複數（Both are）；all/some of + 複數名詞用複數。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: Indefinite pronouns ending in -one, -body, or -thing take a singular verb: 'Everyone is here.' 'Something is wrong.'
claims.verification_ref: -one/-body/-thing 結尾不定代名詞用單數動詞（Everyone is here）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'each' and 'every', and 'neither/either + singular noun', take a singular verb: 'Each of the boys has a book.' 'Neither answer is correct.'
claims.verification_ref: each/every、neither/either+單數名詞用單數動詞（Each of the boys has；Neither answer is）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'both' is plural and takes a plural verb: 'Both of my parents are doctors.'
claims.verification_ref: both 為複數、用複數動詞（Both of my parents are doctors）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'all/some of + plural noun' takes a plural verb ('Some of the books are missing'); 'all/some of + uncountable noun' takes a singular verb ('All of the milk is gone').
claims.verification_ref: all/some of + 複數名詞用複數（Some of the books are missing）；+ 不可數用單數（All of the milk is gone）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Indefinite pronouns ending in -one, -body, or -thing are singular, so they take a singular verb: 'Everyone is here.' 'Something is wrong.'
teach.zh_hint: 以 -one、-body、-thing 結尾的不定代名詞是單數，所以動詞用單數：Everyone is here.（大家都到了。）Something is wrong.（有東西不對勁。）

teach.body: 'each' and 'every' are singular. 'Neither' and 'either' with a singular noun are also singular: 'Each of the boys has a book.' 'Neither answer is correct.'
teach.zh_hint: each 和 every 是單數。neither、either 接單數名詞時也是單數：Each of the boys has a book.（每個男孩都有一本書。）Neither answer is correct.（兩個答案都不對。）

teach.body: Everyone in the class is ready. Each of the students has a locker.
teach.zh_hint: 班上每個人都準備好了（Everyone→is）。每位學生都有一個置物櫃（Each of…→has）。

teach.body: 'both' is plural, so use a plural verb: 'Both of my parents are doctors.' With 'of', the verb follows the noun: 'Some of the books are missing' (plural noun), but 'All of the milk is gone' (uncountable noun).
teach.zh_hint: both 是複數，動詞用複數：Both of my parents are doctors.（我父母都是醫生。）有 of 時，動詞看後面的名詞：Some of the books are missing（複數名詞→are），但 All of the milk is gone（不可數名詞→is）。

teach.body: Both of them are ready. Some of the water is dirty.
teach.zh_hint: 他們兩個都準備好了（both→are）。有些水是髒的（some of + 不可數 water→is）。

practice.stem: 選正確動詞：Everyone in the class ____ ready for the test.

distractor_rationales.are: everyone 是單數，要用單數動詞 is，不是 are。
distractor_rationales.were: everyone 是單數、且句意是現在，用 is。
distractor_rationales.be: 需要有時態的動詞 is，不能用原形 be。

practice.stem: 選正確動詞：Each of the students ____ a locker.

distractor_rationales.have: each of… 看 each，是單數，要用 has，不是 have。
distractor_rationales.having: 需要有時態的動詞 has，不用 -ing 形。
distractor_rationales.had: 句意是現在，用 has，不用過去式 had。

practice.feedback: each of… 是單數：Each of the students has a locker。

practice.stem: 選正確動詞：Both of my parents ____ doctors.

distractor_rationales.is: both 是複數，要用複數動詞 are，不是 is。
distractor_rationales.was: both 是複數、句意現在，用 are。
distractor_rationales.be: 需要有時態的動詞 are，不能用原形 be。

practice.feedback: both 是複數：Both of my parents are doctors。

distractor_rationales.are: neither + 單數名詞（answer）是單數，要用 is。
distractor_rationales.were: neither answer 是單數、句意現在，用 is。
distractor_rationales.be: 需要有時態的動詞 is，不能用原形 be。

practice.feedback: neither + 單數名詞是單數：Neither answer is correct。

practice.stem: 選正確動詞：Some of the books ____ missing from the shelf.

distractor_rationales.is: some of + 複數名詞（books）用複數動詞 are，不是 is。
distractor_rationales.be: 需要有時態的動詞 are，不能用原形 be。

practice.feedback: some of + 複數名詞用複數：Some of the books are missing。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀練習（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：出聲讀句子，一邊讀一邊想「這個數量詞是單數還是複數」，確認動詞配對正確。

lines.text: Everyone in the class is ready for the big test.
Both of my parents are doctors at the same hospital.
